Short title and commencement

ACT XVII OF 1996
ACT XVII OF 1996
POLICE (SINDH
AMENDMENT) ACT, 1966
An Act to amend
the Police Act, 1861, in its application to the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 21st July, 1996]
No. PAS/Legis-B-9/96.---The
Police (Sindh Amendment) Bill, 1996 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 13th June, 1996 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 15th July, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the
Police (Sindh Amendment) Act, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of Certain sections of Act No.V of 1861

ACT XVII OF 1996
ACT XVII OF 1996
POLICE (SINDH
AMENDMENT) ACT, 1966
An Act to amend
the Police Act, 1861, in its application to the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 21st July, 1996]
No. PAS/Legis-B-9/96.---The
Police (Sindh Amendment) Bill, 1996 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 13th June, 1996 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 15th July, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of Certain sections of Act No.V of 1861.--- In the
Police Act, 1861, in sections 28, 32 and 34-A, for the words "two
hundred", the words "five thousand" and in section 34 for the
word "fifty" the words" one thousand" shall be substituted.
